name: Spirograph
description: Draw glowing spirograph patterns: change the ring, wheel and pen, watch them draw themselves and save them.
prompt: A glowing spirograph: sliders for the ring, wheel, pen distance and line width, inside or outside wheels, gradient inks, an animation that draws the curve, random designs and saving the image.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Dibuja patrones de espirógrafo brillantes: cambia el aro, la rueda y el lápiz, mira cómo se dibujan solos y guárdalos.
